messages:
Piotr: Vendor update — thermal batch ETA slipped from Mar 18 -> Mar 25, carrier flagged customs. This impacts 24 H200 units currently allocated to EU pool.
Maria: Ack. Which POs / AWBs?
Piotr: PO: `2309-REDW-INFER-42`, AWB: TB123456789. Vendor says partial RMA allowed but needs pre-shipment inspection proof. They offered an expedited insurance add-on for $1,200.
Ashley: Oof. We already have T2 capacity booking that week. Can we repool capacity from US temp pool to cover EU demand?
Frank: Repool cost delta ~ $5k + extra duties. Paying the $1.2k expedite might be cheaper if it avoids repooling and duty. What's SLA/tail impact?
Piotr: Tail latency SLO could slip for batch jobs — estimated loss of ~12 concurrent EU slots for ~48h if we wait.
Maria: I can shift the canary to US but need procurement signoff. Also need clarity on vendor's RMA window (how many days after delivery) and who signs the insurance add-on. @Lisa?
ops-bot: Reminder: open a procurement ticket with tag `#vendor-esc` and attach AWB + PO + vendor note. Use `/ticket create vendor-esc PO:...` template.
Lisa: Procurement note: historically we covered expedited insurance for DOA cases in Q4; checking contract clause 6.3 now. If clause doesn't cover it, propose asking vendor for 50/50 split.
Ashley: From ops side I can throttle batch ingestion and shift non-critical jobs to off-peak. Will notify product teams. :thumbsup:
Piotr: Question for vendor — can you provide pre-shipment photos and a serial list? If yes, we may accept partial replacement on arrival and avoid air-expedite.
Tom_Vendor: We can provide pre-shipment photos and a full serial list. Insurance add-on available for $1,200; without it claims processing ~10-14 days after arrival.
Frank: Given tradeoffs: propose we accept photo evidence, escalate customs broker clearance, and open procurement ticket to reserve $1,200 contingent funds. Any objections?
Maria: No objections. I'll open the procurement ticket and mark funds as pending approval. Also tagging logistics for RMA label prep on arrival.
Lisa: I'll finish contract read and revert by EOD. If clause disallows coverage, I'll request finance signoff for one-off.
Piotr: Thanks — assigning actions: Maria (procurement ticket + funds), Ashley (throttle + workload shift), Frank (customs broker contact), Lisa (contract review), I'll monitor vendor photos. Ping me for any vendor evidence.
Maria: Done — ticket `PR-8123` opened, attached AWB and PO, vendor note included. Status: pending contract review.
ops-bot: Ticket PR-8123 created by Maria. Workflow: procurement -> finance -> ops. Current status: pending contract review.
Piotr: Quick fallback: if vendor cannot provide photos, fallback is air-replace with 48h expedite and we'll negotiate vendor cost share. Keep updates here.
Tom_Vendor: Noted — we'll upload photos + serial CSV to the ticket within 6 hours and confirm customs broker contact.
Ashley: I'll update the canary run schedule and share a short impact note to #eng-runtime.
Frank: I'll loop in our customs broker (FreightCo) and request a proactive clearance quote.
Maria: Will follow up with finance once Lisa confirms contract. Thanks everyone. :pray:
